name: Arthas Menethil
summary: As plague spreads through Lordaeron, Arthas Menethil leaves his place as its golden prince to hunt those behind it. A paladin of the Silver Hand, he claims Frostmourne in the frozen north, loses his soul, kills King Terenas, and turns against his homeland as the Scourge's champion.

sections.title: The Golden Prince
sections.body: Arthas grew up heir to King Terenas Menethil II, expected to uphold the ideals of the Alliance of Lordaeron. Muradin Bronzebeard trained him in combat, while Uther the Lightbringer guided him into the Order of the Silver Hand. High and low alike looked to him as humanity's future. Bold, skilled, and fiercely protective of his people, he fought Blackrock clan orc incursions and forest troll warbands. Beneath that bright name lived pride and a deep fear of failure.

sections.title: The Scourge and the Culling
sections.body: When the Plague of Undeath took hold in northern Lordaeron, Arthas rode with the sorceress Jaina Proudmoore to stop it spreading. They followed tainted grain from Brill to Andorhal, where Arthas killed the necromancer Kel'Thuzad and learned of the wider plot led by the dreadlord Mal'Ganis. At Stratholme, he found its people infected and chose to kill them before they could turn. He ordered the city's inhabitants slain. Horrified, Uther and Jaina left as Stratholme burned.

sections.title: The Fall and Ascendance
sections.body:
Vengeance drove Arthas into Northrend's frozen wastes, where he met Muradin again and found Frostmourne. He took the runeblade despite its curse and defeated Mal'Ganis. But Frostmourne severed his soul and made him the Lich King's puppet.

As a Death Knight, Arthas returned to Capital City and killed King Terenas with the blade. Lordaeron was left to ash and undeath. He crushed the Silver Hand, besieged Dalaran, and cut through Quel'Thalas. Then he returned to the frozen throne and joined his dark master.

faq.q: Who was Arthas Menethil before his fall?
faq.answer: Before his fall, Arthas was Crown Prince of Lordaeron and heir to King Terenas Menethil II. At nineteen, he joined the Knights of the Silver Hand and was counted among the realm's finest young paladins and swordsmen.

Stratholme's citizens had eaten grain tainted by the Plague of Undeath, and Arthas believed they would rise as mindless undead under Mal'Ganis's control. Convinced no mercy remained, he ordered the whole city slaughtered to prevent a Scourge army from rising.

aliases: why did arthas become death knight
faq.answer: Arthas pursued Mal'Ganis to Northrend and claimed Frostmourne, a cursed runeblade forged by the Lich King. It drained his soul and bound his mind to Ner'zhul, making him the Scourge's vanguard death knight.

After Frostmourne claimed Arthas, he returned to Capital City as a conqueror come home. In the throne room, bells rang and rose petals fell as he drew the runeblade and drove it through his father, King Terenas.

faq.q: What was Arthas's relationship with Jaina Proudmoore?
faq.answer: In their youth, Arthas and Jaina Proudmoore shared a romance, and she rode beside him as he fought the plague. His cruelty at Stratholme drove her away.

Arthas now rules the Scourge from Northrend. After the defense of the frozen throne against the demon hunter Illidan, he ascended Icecrown, broke the Lich King's icy prison, and joined his essence with Ner'zhul.

angles.text: For the Silver Hand, Arthas is its greatest tragedy and shame. His fall corrupted the ideals of justice and protection Uther tried to teach him.
Lordaeron's destruction split the human race in two. Refugees scattered across the globe, leaving Stormwind as humanity's last great seat of power.
The Forsaken hate Arthas above all. Under Queen Sylvanas, they broke free of the dark prince's mental thrall and seek vengeance for their damnation.
Arthas's treason cost the Alliance of Lordaeron its greatest kingdom, its capital, and the legendary paladin order that had anchored human faith.
